t: This is Granville Park, a street in the London Borough of Lewisham. It's a quiet residential road, and two people are connected to it. William Caine, a British colonial administrator, died here. He was the first head of the Hong Kong Police Force, served as Colonial Secretary of Hong Kong from 1846 to 1854, and was acting Governor for a few months in 1859. Jeremy Aubin, a New Zealand judge, was born here. It's a small street with an unexpectedly wide reach, from Hong Kong to New Zealand.
